purpose: The style partition pinned row by row: which class each catalog row carries, as reviewed. A count per class is blind to two rows trading classes; this roster is not.
direction: Exact per-row pin. partition is FROZEN at the first pin and is never edited again; only reclassified and retired change. A class move lands through reclassified, whose value carries the new class and the written reason; a row leaves only through retired, whose value is the written reason; an empty reason is refused. The effective pin is partition with every valid reclassified entry applied and every retired row removed, read by pinnedClasses() in both the gate and its suite; a row whose declared class differs from the effective pin, a declared row it does not name, and a pinned row the partition no longer declares are each red by name. rowsEverPinned is the union of pinned and retired rows, so a row cannot leave the pin by being quietly deleted from it. What this cannot check is whether a reason is true, or a class move written straight into partition: since partition is frozen, any diff on partition is by itself the review signal.
